canonical_definition: Language Understanding is the capability of artificial systems to process, interpret, and derive meaning from natural language inputs, encompassing tasks such as semantic comprehension, text classification, reasoning, and recognizing linguistic relationships. This construct is often operationalized through performance on standardized benchmarks (e.g., GLUE, MMLU, HellaSwag) and involves mapping language to structured representations, contextual knowledge integration, and executing instructions to generate contextually appropriate responses. While some definitions emphasize foundational aspects like semantic similarity or multi-subject question handling, others highlight its role in enabling advanced reasoning or interaction with multimodal data, reflecting its broad application in natural language processing tasks.
